cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); Edgar Levy, New York, NY, 1925; Descended in family; Richard L. Feigen & Co., Inc., New York, NY, 1965; Private collection, Milwaukee, Wisconsin, 1965; (Guggenheim, Asher Associates, Inc., New York, NY); Christie's, New York, NY, sale no. 5272, lot no. 300, 1 June 1983 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "See gallery photograph 4–k. Note: O'Keeffe told me she meant to paint some more on this but it was sold before she had a chance to really finish it." Whitney Archive dates 1922. Downtown Gallery Archive dates c. 1921 and 1922. Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1922. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 15. Reproduced in *The Arts* (October 1923). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Lake George

description: A lake with a white beach stretches across the foreground of the work. In the distance, brown and green mountains rise against a gray sky filled with rippling clouds.
title: Lake George
